subject: StarlitCare demo — preflight gating, vendor attestation & calendar fallback
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Sanders <jordan.sanders@starlitcare.com>, Procurement Portal <procurement@starlitcare.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: StarlitCare demo — preflight gating, vendor attestation & calendar fallback

Hi Jordan / Procurement team,

Thanks again for lining up the demo. Quick update from our side before we lock the time: your procurement portal flagged the supplier attestation and SSO role mapping as outstanding items in the intake checklist. Our standard security preflight requires either the completed attestation + SSO test accounts OR, if you prefer to move faster, we can provide an in-scope recorded walkthrough + a short live Q&A for stakeholders.

To avoid repeated calendar churn while your procurement team processes the portal items, can you confirm which of the following you'd prefer?

1) Live interactive demo (preferred) — procurement completes attestation + provides at least one test SSO account by EOD 2027-04-08. We then run a 45-minute demo with the pilot team.
2) Asynchronous path — we deliver a tailored 20-minute recorded walkthrough and hold a 30-minute “office hours” Q&A for execs and integrators (good if travel/availability is tight).
3) Limited pilot preview — we run a restricted preview using the Redwood Private staging instance while attestation is pending (requires a short technical intake call).

If option 1 is feasible, please upload the signed attestation (attached form for reference) and share the portal ticket ID. If not, we can proceed with option 2 on short notice — I can drop the recording by Friday and propose two half-hour Q&A slots next week.

Attaching our preflight checklist and a blank supplier attestation for your procurement team to complete (stubs attached).

Thanks,
— Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com | +1-415-555-0194

Attachments: starlitcare_supplier_attestation.pdf (PDF, 24 KB); redwood_preflight_checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 12 KB)

From: Jordan Sanders <jordan.sanders@starlitcare.com>

Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: StarlitCare demo — preflight gating, vendor attestation & calendar fallback

Hi Kimberly — thanks for the clear options and for the attachments. Apologies, procurement is swamped this week and the portal still shows a couple of missing fields (data retention and encryption key management sections). Legal also needs to sign the NDA before the attestation moves forward; our legal lead is traveling and returns next Wednesday (2027-04-07).

Short version: we can't lock an interactive demo before next Friday unless we take the async route. Procurement suggested the recorded walkthrough + a single office-hours session while they finish the portal intake. I uploaded the portal ticket (ID: PR-8714) and attached the procurement note (portal references the missing fields).

Could you send the recorded walkthrough by EOD Friday? A 30-minute Q&A on Monday or Tuesday (2027-04-05 or 2027-04-06) late morning PDT would work for our product and infra leads.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Sanders
Senior Product Manager, Integrations | StarlitCare
jordan.sanders@starlitcare.com | +1-617-555-0228

Subject: Re: StarlitCare demo — preflight gating, vendor attestation & calendar fallback

Thanks Jordan — appreciate the quick update and the portal ticket ID.

We can absolutely do the async path. Plan:
- We will record a tailored 18–22 minute walkthrough focused on the integration touchpoints you flagged (SSO, data retention defaults, and key rotation).
- Deliverable: private Share link + a short one-page integration checklist.
- Proposed office-hours Q&A windows (PDT): 2027-04-05 10:30–11:00 or 2027-04-06 11:30–12:00. Please confirm which works and we'll reserve the slot.

Karthik — can you build the short walkthrough and include a 5-minute segment showing our recommended SSO role mappings? Marissa — I'll include you for the office-hours logistics and a one-pager summarizing the portal fields procurement flagged.

If procurement finishes the attestation sooner, we'll convert to an interactive demo and remove the office-hours — we'll stay flexible.

— Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
